# edgeos_interface_switch (Resource)

Settings of a switch interface (`interfaces switch <name>`), such as `switch0` on an EdgeRouter X.

Creating the resource takes the switch over when it exists and creates it otherwise. Only the attributes you set are managed. Anything you leave out (and every option this resource does not model, such as per-port `vlan` settings or `dhcpv6-pd`) is neither read nor changed. Removing an attribute from the configuration removes that setting from the switch. Import reads every modelled setting the switch has.

Destroying the resource removes the settings it manages and keeps the switch itself. Removing `addresses`, `switch_ports` or `firewall_*` from the switch you reach the router through can cut you off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_firewall_name" "lan_in" {
  name = "LAN_IN"
}

# The built-in switch of an EdgeRouter X, made VLAN aware, with eth1 left out
# for use as a separate port.
resource "edgeos_interface_switch" "lan" {
  name         = "switch0"
  description  = "Local"
  addresses    = ["192.168.1.1/24"]
  switch_ports = ["eth2", "eth3", "eth4"]
  vlan_aware   = true
  firewall_in  = edgeos_firewall_name.lan_in.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Switch name, such as `switch0`. Changing it manages a different switch.

### Optional

- `addresses` (Set of String) Addresses of the switch: addresses with prefix length such as `192.0.2.1/24` or `2001:db8::1/64`, or `dhcp` / `dhcpv6` to use a DHCP client.
- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `dhcp_options` (Attributes) DHCP client options, used with `addresses = ["dhcp"]`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dhcp_options))
- `disabled` (Boolean) `true` switches the switch interface off (the `disable` node), `false` makes sure it is on. Leave it unset to not manage it.
- `firewall_in` (String) Name of the IPv4 firewall rule set applied to traffic coming in on the interface and forwarded (`firewall in name`). The rule set has to exist, usually `edgeos_firewall_name.x.name`; EdgeOS refuses the commit otherwise.
- `firewall_local` (String) Name of the IPv4 firewall rule set applied to traffic coming in on the interface for the router itself (`firewall local name`). The rule set has to exist, usually `edgeos_firewall_name.x.name`; EdgeOS refuses the commit otherwise.
- `firewall_out` (String) Name of the IPv4 firewall rule set applied to traffic forwarded out of the interface (`firewall out name`). The rule set has to exist, usually `edgeos_firewall_name.x.name`; EdgeOS refuses the commit otherwise.
- `mac` (String) MAC address to use instead of the hardware address, in lower case.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU from 68 to 9000. The hardware may support less.
- `switch_ports` (Set of String) Ethernet ports in the switch (`switch-port interface <port>`), such as `["eth2", "eth3"]`. The resource owns the whole list: ports that are not in it are taken out of the switch, including their per-port VLAN settings. Settings below a port that stays in the list are kept. The ports have to exist.
- `vlan_aware` (Boolean) Make the switch VLAN aware (`switch-port vlan-aware`). `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The switch name.

<a id="nestedatt--dhcp_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dhcp_options`

Optional:

- `client_options` (List of String) Lines EdgeOS adds to the interface section of `dhclient.conf` (`dhcp-options client-option`), in order, such as `send dhcp-client-identifier 01:02:00:5e:00:53:01;`. Double quotes are not allowed, so write strings as hex bytes. When unset, `edgeos_interface_ethernet` and `edgeos_interface_switch` leave existing lines alone, while `edgeos_interface_vif`, which owns its VLAN interface, removes them.
- `default_route` (Boolean) Install the default route the DHCP server hands out. `true` writes `update`, `false` writes `no-update`.
- `default_route_distance` (Number) Administrative distance of the default route learned from DHCP, from 1 to 255.
- `global_options` (List of String) Lines EdgeOS adds to the global section of `dhclient.conf` (`dhcp-options global-option`), in order, such as `option rfc3442-classless-static-routes code 121 = array of unsigned integer 8;`. Double quotes are not allowed, so write strings as hex bytes. When unset, `edgeos_interface_ethernet` and `edgeos_interface_switch` leave existing lines alone, while `edgeos_interface_vif`, which owns its VLAN interface, removes them.
- `name_server` (Boolean) Use the DNS servers the DHCP server hands out. `true` writes `update`, `false` writes `no-update`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_interface_switch.lan
  id = "switch0"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_interface_switch.lan 'switch0'
```
